{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星皆晦，惟一福專權，又化為催官，或為三元，又值","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427412499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"禄旺之地，不以晝夜為忌，此是大格局。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427412499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有官禄從陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427428883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"若在弱宫，與命相戰，皆不取用，與身命相資者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427428883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"一、犯三刑勾絞，如夘刑子，是子上泊命者，八字日支又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427445267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179513892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"是子日者，四旬外行夘限，犯刑而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427445267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丑刑戌，身命","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427461651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"主起在戌上，又日支是戌，再行煞地，必犯刑死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427461651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"若日干","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427478035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"不相干，犯行煞限，或獄中死，或生毒死，守星善善死，犯","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427478035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"者終非是吉人。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427478035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命坐劒廉，刄鋒無星壓者，若星得局，主發用貴顯，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427494419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"限遇諸殺井沓重者，亦主死于非命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427494419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"行煞地或見㐫","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427510803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"星，火羅計孛，發惡瘡死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427510803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"又如坐有吉星，限遇煞交併，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427527187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"主横死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427527187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"有壬申生人，七月夘時，星日泊命，水輔陽在午，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427543571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928559650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符卦氣在局，中年保為訓導。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427543571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉流年，六十二嵗，限","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"交室火見計，六月被同僚打死檢屍，此是羊刄與木對","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"照于命申反刑亥，加勾絞，亡神貫索在亥，炁月在丑，羅","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"土在巳酉，諸煞交攻故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"一、安命立身坐，實占髙強。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427576339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"且如六辛生人，酉上泊命，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427592723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉日最佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427592723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"若身命福，禄星好，一二品格，戌為刄處安","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427609107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"命，遇戌亥日㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427609107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐日支為第一，坐年月時者次之。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427625491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427641875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"如金生在巳遇巳巳日又是巳上安命，文星旺官髙。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427641875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427658259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928543266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"如木旺在夘，又遇夘日，更安命在夘，大貴之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427658259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八字有合，天月二徳，命度身好，大貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427674643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"或時帶天月","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427691027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"二徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427691027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"假如巳生人，寅戌為天月二徳，日月時有寅戌又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427707411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"相合為竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427707411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八字天亡，先論日干支要𦂳，假如乙酉日，便不宜庚","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427723795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"辰時，謂羊刄交合故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427723795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四月泊命，月起失經土計或羅孛帶殺夾拱，夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427740179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427756563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"水雖好，若帶重煞交拱，亦不乆長。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427756563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺太隂只宜獨居","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427772947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725205938239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"夜深，火金與月助光相宜，帶天元中舉，與孛同躔，妨母。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427772947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"若有坐位，巳不妨，寒月不可同居。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427789331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"一、孛隨火後行，大限忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427805715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"若四火安命，或火命人生壽","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427822099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"不長，火旺尤可，隔二三度主夭，十六度外有援亦不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427822099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四木安命，木土同度得躔，又得生旺，財帛擁進，更財","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427838483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"福二官有吉星扶為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427838483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四日泊命，不宜木炁與日同躔，日生人主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427920403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"若火羅","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427936787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"日同躔，只不益尊親，於巳不妨，惟四日不怕飛亷火。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427936787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"一、帶華盖，主聰明，宦官帶華盖者多。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427953171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐旺地，行庫限不吉，或死亡，或剥官，有援不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428035091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"一、壬癸生人，土為羊刄，又為血支血忌，若四水或月度","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428051475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"安命，土計尅度，主血光灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428051475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"如是五六月為飛亷，必主天。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428067859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰金命生人，見土不甚㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428084243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"一、坐天狗，主無子，如癸酉五月未時命坐角，丁酉日者，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428100627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017674794614784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"木月同度在室，有子無官。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428100627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌日者，月躔壁水，有官無","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428117011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428117011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"予想身度主朝天，月為天狗，得水光彩，所以無子有","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428133395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428133395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"又有坐天狗者，加火孛，不吉，照命限，必然無子。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428149779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"若得","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428166163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星者，又當有子，不可執一論之。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428166163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗在男女宫主受","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428182547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，亦難子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428182547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"如六癸六庚生人，安命在丑，木為文魁，金為官魁，庚用","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055906346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"木為正魁，金為官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055906346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"故詩曰：丙已相逢癸與庚，隂陽磨","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055922730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"竭兩宫亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055922730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁金木升晨殿，白屋還應出監𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055939114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"正謂此","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055955498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055955498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"　六戌生人安命在午，金為官在酉，火為魁在邜。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055971882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055988266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"已生人命在未，金為魁在辰，火為官在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055988266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸生人命","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056004650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017796278452234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"在已，木為魁在寅，水為官在申。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056004650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"合此最竒。","logicSenten {"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759209193523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"如太隂在未，命與孛在卯，此横漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056135722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"生於夜者極清","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056152106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，若乙已乙亥生人，不取，以其衝破天闗故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056152106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"又格身命在未，木在卯，縱漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056168490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"身命在夘，木在未，横","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056184874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056184874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"盖亥宫無星，漏一木𧺫来用事，亦是一説。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056201258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"此二","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056217642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"星卯木二宫往来，俱為得地，所為合貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056217642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"日從陽，夜從隂，如日生人，寅午戌、申子、辰坐命，以日土","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056234026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"木水用事；夜生安命已酉、丑、亥、卯、未，以月金火用事，為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056234026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"福最厚。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056234026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"若日從隂，夜從陽，則為背，乃隂錯陽差，為福最","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056250410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017685280440361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056250410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：三方若背，其人空貴無官。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056266794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"一安命煞前主後。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056283178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"如已酉生，安命在子，木為煞星在亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056299562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"居命之前；土為命主，居煞之後。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056299562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"一前一後，各得其地，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134369343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"者冨貴可知，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134369343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"或命限之主釣起，值煞星居前，不","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134385727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"能反尅者，不以㐫㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134385727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"愚意此説未穏。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134402111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"凡已生人，子宫安命者，以木為財福","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134418495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"星，果老，以財福尅命為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134418495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"五星經亦云：若還有用不為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134434879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，權重凛威風。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134434879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"二經皆不以木為忌，此處獨言凶者，恐","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134451263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496405540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"亦未究財福尅命之説歟？","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134451263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"聊述鄙見，以候知者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134467647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"一人命多有生時不定，以子為亥，以亥為子，以初為末，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134484031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"以末為初，則坐度不同，星辰轉動，故曰言禍福不凖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134484031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"須","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134500415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"是加减定其灾祥，受生受尅，方能言其吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134500415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：一不","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134516799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"可拘，二須敢斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134516799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"以禍福不應，未可㨿言休咎必然之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134533183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵村落之人，無譙樓更鼓，又有晦㝠風雨，氣候不齊，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134549567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"難以定時。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134549567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"又有溺愛而明者，聞人説此時為凶，彼時為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134565951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，便以吉者為主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134565951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"故禍福不應，推命者當意消詳詳之，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134582335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017674794909696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"不可以誤傳誤，自壞術法可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134582335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"一夾命要曰：月夾命，福祿夾命，官魁夾命，印貴夾命，三","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134598719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"合拱之者亦然，皆主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134598719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"或命度主，身度主，起坐别處","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134615103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"而夾拱之者，但無剥雜，皆是大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134615103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"735","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"一刼殺的殺亡神、羊刃之宫，或吉星夾其上者，其凶暴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134631487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"不可勝言，致死於非命。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134631487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
